trajectory_clusters.common_pattern: OfficeQA Treasury Bulletin questions where the target issue is identified by a calendar month, calendar year, fiscal year, or security maturity date, requiring publication-lag reasoning (monthly lag, fiscal year-end in September issue, calendar year-end preliminary in next March issue, full-year maturity schedule in January issue) plus table identification by code and cross-bulletin confirmation.
trajectory_clusters.evidence: Every trajectory selects a bulletin issue by date reasoning before extracting data: July data read from September issues, fiscal year-end from September issues, December year-end preliminary from next-year March issues, full-year maturities from the January issue, and August-issue narrative for July 1984 maturity. Several trajectories cross-confirm the same snapshot in a later bulletin.

trajectory_clusters.common_pattern: After source location, all trajectories extract numeric cells from a multi-column Treasury Bulletin table, verify column/header mapping (monthly sum equals annual total, multi-block year-to-column-group maps), convert units (thousands to millions, millions to nominal), compute an aggregate (percentage, geometric mean, logarithmic growth rate, population standard deviation, sum, absolute difference, average spread), cross-validate against a published total or independent issue, round per the question spec, and format the output (bracketed CSV, percent without sign, plain value).
trajectory_clusters.evidence: Trajectories show column-mapping verification by summing monthly columns against the annual total, unit conversion from thousands to millions, distinct aggregates (geometric mean via log method, population std dev dividing by n, ln(end/start) growth rate, average monthly spread), cross-validation against published totals or a second bulletin, and explicit rounding rules (2 decimals, 6 decimals, 5 significant digits, percent format 0.1234 to 12.34).

changes.summary: New skill for mapping a requested reporting period to the correct Treasury Bulletin issue and table via publication-lag conventions, with cross-bulletin confirmation.
New skill for extracting and verifying table cells, unit conversion, computing the requested aggregate, cross-validation, rounding, and output formatting.
